acoustic_fabric.notes: Charcoal heathered wool/felt acoustic panel fabric, very rough.

berlin_cobbles.notes: Dry grey granite setts (Kopfsteinpflaster), 14 courses along U, dusty sand/brick-dust joints.

berlin_render_facade.notes: Grey-ochre lime render, V up, moulded string courses every 0.9 m (at V≈0.25 and 0.75), soot, chips to red brick, bullet and shrapnel pocks.

berlin_sidewalk.notes: Berlin sidewalk: granite slab band (V 0.25-0.75, slabs along U) with small granite mosaic setts either side; map V across the sidewalk. Dry, dust and brick grit in joints.

brick_french.notes: Hand-made red-brown French farmhouse brick, running bond (16 courses x 4 bricks per tile), recessed lime mortar, soot, efflorescence, damaged bricks.

brushed_steel.notes: Brushed stainless steel, metalness 1, brushing along U (anisotropic streaks in roughness/normal).

canvas_tent.notes: Weathered khaki/off-white cotton duck canvas: tension wrinkles, tide-line water stains, mildew, felled seam along U at V≈0.7.

cellar_whitewash.notes: Whitewashed brick cellar wall (26 courses), flaking; rising damp, salts and mould below V≈0.3. V up, V=0 = floor.

chalk_spoil.notes: Somme chalk spoil: angular white-grey chalk lumps, flints, brown earth matrix and chalk fines; parapets / spoil heaps.

cob_torchis.notes: Ochre-brown earth-and-straw cob infill, shrinkage cracks, straw and grit, limewash remnants.

cobblestone_wet.notes: Wet worn grey setts in irregular courses along U, mud joints, puddles (roughness ~0.06).

concrete_board.notes: Board-formed architectural concrete: 16 x 150 mm boards along U with wood-grain imprint, fins, 600 mm tie-hole grid, bug holes.

concrete_platform.notes: Worn platform concrete; worn white painted 150 mm strip along U at V≈0.1 (platform edge side = V=0); expansion joint at U=0.

concrete_polished.notes: Polished/sealed concrete floor with ground exposed aggregate, power-trowel swirls, pinholes; roughness ~0.2-0.4.

corrugated_iron.notes: Galvanised corrugated sheet, 13 corrugations per tile (~76 mm pitch), ridges along V; heavy rust (metalness 0) over zinc (metalness 1), nail row at V≈0.9. Corrugation is in the normal map only.

crate_wood.notes: Supply-crate boards (7 per tile, grain along U), faded grey-green paint worn to grey wood, nails; no stencils.

dirt_lane.notes: Dry rutted farm lane running along V; map U across the lane: wheel ruts at U≈0.27/0.73, grass strip at U≈0.5, hoof prints, stones.

earth_wall.notes: Spade-cut trench wall, V = up: layered loam/clay strata (periodic over the tile), chalk flecks, flints, roots, spade facets, damp seeps.

floorboards_interior.notes: Dusty pine floorboards, 8 x 150 mm boards along U, butt joints, cut nails on 400 mm joists, plaster crumbs.

grass_dead.notes: Matted dead autumn grass, tussocks and fallen leaves over wet mud (behind-the-lines ground).

grass_summer.notes: Lush June meadow grass with clover and white clover flowers, few bare patches.

hedgerow_bank.notes: Bocage earth bank, vertical (V up): soil, roots, stones, ferns, glossy ivy, grass tufts.

interior_paint_distemper.notes: Two-tone distemper: faded green below the dado line at V≈0.4, cream above, dark lining stripe; cracked, flaking, water stains. V up.

interior_wallpaper.notes: Faded 1930s floral wallpaper (half-drop repeat, strip seams at U=0/0.5), torn to plaster, water stains (V up), mould.

limestone_ashlar.notes: Pale Caen-type limestone ashlar, 6 courses of 0.33 m, weathered: alveolar pitting, claw marks, black crust, lichen.

london_stock_brick.notes: Yellow-brown London stock brick, Flemish bond (14 courses, 3 stretcher+header units per tile), heavy soot, blackened lime mortar.

london_stock_brick_band.notes: Accent-course option: identical wall to london_stock_brick with one red-brick course at V≈0.55; use for one band row of a facade.

mud_wet.notes: Churned Somme trench-floor mud (brown-grey clay), boot prints, ruts along U, flint/chalk stones; puddles = roughness ~0.07 areas.

norman_stone_rubble_wall.notes: Random rubble masonry: grey-brown granite and schist, small pinning stones, recessed lime mortar, lichen.

oak_veneer.notes: Fumed dark-oak flat-cut veneer, 4 leaves of 30 cm per tile (seams and grain along U), pores and ray flecks, satin lacquer.

orchard_bark.notes: Gnarled apple-tree bark, scaly plates flaking to orange-brown underbark, lichen, algae; V along the trunk.

painted_wood.notes: Chipped dark-green enamel over cream undercoat and red-oxide primer on softwood, scuffed; grain along U.

parquet_oak.notes: Herringbone oak parquet (70 x 354 mm slats at ±45°, zig-zag along U), worn, dusty, a few missing slats showing bitumen.

pavement_flags.notes: Wet York stone flags in 3 courses along U; map V across the pavement with the kerb side at V=0 (more dirt, puddles: roughness ~0.06).

plaster_damaged.notes: Lime plaster over rubble-stone masonry, flaking to expose the stones, cracks, water run-down stains (V = up).

pump_iron_green.notes: Dark-green painted cast iron chipped through red-lead primer to rust, rust bleeding downwards (V up).

render_stucco.notes: Cream lime stucco ruled as ashlar (5 courses of 0.4 m), soot streaks running down (V up), cracks, patches, spalls showing brick.

roof_tiles.notes: Terracotta interlocking 'tuiles mécaniques' (5 x 3 tiles per tile), moss and lichen, dirt in the flutes; eaves/down-slope towards V=0 (image bottom).

rubble_brick_plaster.notes: Heap surface: broken red brick, plaster lumps, mortar, splinters, heavy light dust.

rusty_steel.notes: Pitted, flaking rusty steel with mill-scale remnants and bare-metal scratches (metalness 1 only there).

sandbag.notes: Coarse jute hessian sack weave (~4.5 threads/cm), wet, mud-clogged; one stitched seam runs along U at V≈0.22. Bag shape comes from geometry.

sandbag_dry.notes: Dry, newer jute hessian (lighter variant of sandbag), dusty not muddy; stitched seam along U at V≈0.22.

slate_roof.notes: Welsh slate roof, 4 slates x 5 rows (200 mm gauge), broken bond, rows along U; V points up the roof (tails at the bottom of each row). Moss, lichen, slipped slates.

soot_scorch.notes: Charred timber (alligator char), checks elongated along U, ash and brown unburnt wood in cracks; very dark albedo.

stone_rubble.notes: Shattered masonry rubble: brick, limestone, mortar and tile fragments in plaster/brick dust.

tarmac_road.notes: Old wet tar-macadam: exposed chippings, wheel tracks along U, crocodile and longitudinal cracks, tar patches, puddles in ruts. No tram rails.

terrazzo_stair.notes: Worn grey terrazzo; darker border band along U at V 0-0.12 (nosing side) behind a brass divider (metalness 1).

thatch_roof.notes: Weathered straw thatch, V up the roof (stalk butts face down-slope), moss, faint 25 cm courses.

tile_station.notes: Cream glazed wall tiles in half bond (6 x 12 per tile) with a two-course green band at V≈0.3; crazing, chips, grime. No logos or text.

timber_frame_oak.notes: Weathered silver-grey oak beams, eroded grain along U, deep checks, oak pegs, lichen.

wicker_hurdle.notes: Woven brushwood revetment hurdle: horizontal rods woven round 4 vertical stakes per tile (25 cm).

wood_beam.notes: Rough band-sawn timber, dark and damp, drying checks and knots; grain along U.

wood_planks.notes: Weathered wet softwood planks, 6 horizontal boards per tile (grain along U), butt joints, nails with rust streaks, mud splashes on the bottom board (V=0).
